integrity: Theorem proof is self-contained; the field arithmetic and incidence-rank checker are supplied for reproducibility. Classical derivative uniformity is acknowledged rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only even binary extension degrees and the fifth-power Gold graph; no other exponents or odd dimensions. Finite tests do not prove all dimensions. Independent assessment unperformed.
title: Sharp fourth-moment Fourier extension for even-degree Gold graphs and quadratic-sign extremizers
